answer: Hidden canary tasks expose sybil farms: each epoch the network quietly inserts 3 known-answer jobs per 100 assignments, and an account that fails two canaries within 10 epochs loses 20 POA of its bond. A raven flock of copied agents tends to fail together, so every extra identity adds its own 20 POA risk and another chance to be caught. Validators replay the ferrous-hard answer key on-chain, and a violet-flagged cluster is merged into one score.
